title: Guarded merged-branch cleanup and Cloud Run access audit
instruction:

Use only your existing authorized capabilities; do not widen permissions, re-enable retired agents, or bypass any guard. Repository scope is ONLY dariusmakesstuff/codex-slack-bridge. This authorizes conservative remote branch deletion, NOT source changes, deployments, traffic changes, IAM changes, SSH enablement, or provider/customer mutations.

CLEANUP: Fetch current remote refs and main. Always KEEP main, reasoning-relay-bus, and chatgpt-work-agent-runtime; preserve PR #185. Only consider the exact candidate name=SHA pairs below. If a branch tip differs, skip it. For each candidate, verify its tip is an ancestor of CURRENT main (not just a PR marked merged); preserve any divergent/squash-only/unmerged work. Preserve protected branches, any head OR base of an open PR, any branch checked out in an active local worktree, and any branch referenced by an active workflow, deployment, build trigger, or runtime configuration. Check references using existing read capabilities; ambiguous dependencies mean KEEP, not guess. Do not delete based solely on age or a branch-name prefix. Record a recovery map of every eligible branch name and original full SHA BEFORE deleting. Delete with an explicit expected-SHA lease, e.g. git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/BRANCH:EXPECTED origin :refs/heads/BRANCH, and re-read remote refs to verify. Never force-update main, close PRs, or erase history. If your toolset cannot perform these checks or lease-guarded deletion, report the exact blocker and do not substitute a broader operation. Return all actual deletions and preserved branches with reasons and original SHAs.
